answer: Resist sybils with random live spot-checks: each epoch, a random slice of identities must pass a short, unscripted live interview — a fresh puzzle plus follow-up questions — inside a narrow window, judged by rotating independent auditors. An honest agent anchors its identity in one real mind, steady through the tide of checks. A farmer's thousand clones face a voyage they cannot fake: each fake needs a live operator thinking in real time, and one person cannot puppet a thousand interviews at once. Presence becomes the price.
